sectors.name: Technology
themes: AI infrastructure capex remains the dominant structural driver, with CRWV and COHR surging on data-center demand, sustaining premium valuations for US-listed enablers.
Indonesia's tech sector underperforms due to thin liquidity and limited AI exposure, forcing investors to overweight US-listed tech for beta and innovation leverage.
Cloud and enterprise software consolidation (ORCL, GDDY) is accelerating, creating durable recurring-revenue moats that outperform cyclical hardware names.
sectors.ai: Rotate into AI-infrastructure and data-center beneficiaries (CRWV, NBIS, COHR) and US-listed software leaders (ORCL, META) for near-term upside; trim Indonesia-listed tech laggards (ID -0.49%) as foreign flows favor US names. Maintain normal risk, add on dips to high-momentum AI plays, and avoid chasing DIVA's speculative spike without earnings confirmation.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: AI data-center load growth is structurally re-rating US independent power producers (VST, CEG, NRG) as 24/7 clean firming contracts outcompete merchant volatility.
US solar module and inverter pricing has bottomed, driving margin expansion for FSLR, ENPH, and SEDG as IRA domestic-content credits lock in cost advantages through 2026.
Indonesian renewables remain policy-capped and grid-constrained, forcing capital to migrate to US climate-tech equities for liquidity and tariff certainty.
sectors.ai: Buy the US solar/utility complex on the AI-driven power demand supercycle; FSLR's 12% surge confirms module pricing bottoming and IRA clarity. Rotate out of Indonesian renewables laggards (-1.54%) toward US-listed pure-plays (SEDG, ARRY, RUN) and IPPs (VST, CEG) with contracted PPAs. Expect 15-20% upside in next 6 months as grid bottlenecks ease and data-center load accelerates.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's rising middle-class disposable income continues to drive premiumization in snack and beverage categories, favoring nimble mid-caps over bulky conglomerates.
Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are structurally lowering go-to-market costs for smaller FMCG brands, enabling outsized volume growth versus traditional retail.
Regulatory stability and food-security policies are creating a supportive backdrop for domestic consumer manufacturers, reducing input-cost volatility and boosting margin predictability.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names with confirmed volume breakouts (JELI, IATA, BACH) while avoiding large-cap laggards; the sector's mild aggregate gain masks strong rotational momentum into smaller consumer plays. Position for 2-4 week continuation as US-listed peers (+0.46%) confirm demand, but trim into any 15%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's e-commerce penetration, still below 20% of retail, drives double-digit parcel volume growth that structurally benefits domestic last-mile operators like MITI and TRUK.
Government infrastructure spending on ports, toll roads, and the IKN project lowers logistics costs per unit, improving margins for asset-heavy players (KPIG, PURA) over the next 3-5 years.
Urbanization and the rise of on-demand delivery in Jakarta/Surabaya create durable demand for taxi-based and micro-freight logistics (TAXI, LOPI), insulated from US trade cycles.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on domestic names (MITI, TRUK) riding e-commerce parcel volume and port efficiency gains; US weakness is a headwind only for exporters. Accumulate TAXI/LOPI as urban last-mile proxies with tariff-free growth. Trim any US-exposed positions. Sector signal NORMAL supports adding on dips, not chasing +30% spikes.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto tax and Bappebti licensing regime remains a structural drag, capping local exchange volumes and forcing institutional flows offshore.
US macro easing and spot ETF inflows are the dominant global driver, transmitting volatility to IDX-listed fintech proxies rather than direct crypto exposure.
Stablecoin adoption for cross-border trade and remittance is a durable local growth vector, outpacing speculative altcoin demand in Indonesia.
sectors.ai: Buy the US-led crypto rebound selectively: BTC-linked and liquid alts (ADA, DOT, ALGO) are outperforming on risk-on flows, but Indonesia's regulatory overhang and thin local liquidity cap upside. Rotate into HELOC and ENA for yield-driven momentum, trim ZEC/HYPE on low conviction. Maintain 5-10% tactical allocation, hedge with USD stablecoins.
